title: Aakar Experiences v1 (Duniya) and viewer environments (Mahaul)
description: Experiences are a curation layer on the Shop: a theme that ties a page surface and a stage backdrop to a set of outcome families (Avatars), curated Shop items, a default style, a motif pack and seasons. They add no geometry. Environments are the viewer backdrops that experiences, families, template descriptors and Shop items name; each is rendered by a storefront preset (code), while which backdrop a piece uses is data. Seeded from packages/design-tokens/experiences.json, stored in environments / experiences / experience_avatars / experience_items, edited in the management portal. Code ids stay snake_case English; brand names (codename, title, tagline) are data.

iso_date.description: A calendar date, e.g. 2026-10-20: a one-off window.

month_day.description: An ISO 8601 month-day, e.g. --10-01: a window that recurs every year and may wrap the new year (--12-20 to --01-05).

environment.description: A viewer backdrop (Mahaul). Read-only reference data until presets become uploadable; adding one is an engineering task (a preset in the storefront viewer) plus a seed row.

id.description: What experiences, families, template descriptors and Shop items name as their `environment`.

label.description: Plain name shown in the portal, e.g. 'Chettinad teak · candlelight'.

surface.description: The surface the backdrop sits on: stage (the indigo viewer) or paper (cream browsing pages).

preset_key.description: The storefront viewer preset that renders it (apps/web src/lib/viewer/environments.ts, keyed like packages/design-tokens/tokens.json environments). Several backdrops may share a preset.

palette.description: Swatches for the portal's Backgrounds page and theme previews, the backdrop colour first.

surface.description: Page theming for the experience. The cream paper stays (ADR-0001); the accent and the hero change.

accent.description: Accent for chips, links and buttons on the experience page, from the brand palette.

paper_tint.description: A light tint laid over the cream paper; null keeps plain cream.

hero_media.description: URL or site path of the page's hero image or loop; null until one is shot (the page then leads with the stage strip).

collection.description: A sub-collection inside an experience, e.g. a licensed universe with its own motif pack. Katha keeps none until a licence exists.

licence_ref.description: Reference to the licence agreement that allows the collection; null for original work.

season_window.description: When the experience is in season (a badge on the Shop, e.g. 'Diwali'). Both ends are calendar dates (starts_on ≤ ends_on) or both are month-days (recurring every year).

id.description: snake_case English and never renamed (festive, desk_gaming, memories, kids_party, comics); designs.experience_id references it.

codename.description: Brand name shown to customers, e.g. 'Utsav'. Portal-editable.

slug.description: URL slug of the experience page (/duniya/<slug>), unique. Editable, but links change with it.

title.description: Plain descriptor always shown with the codename, e.g. 'Festive & gifting'.

environment.description: The backdrop (an environments id): the experience page's stage strip and the studio preset.

style.description: Default style variant the studio presets (the design-spec.v1.json style values).

motif_pack.description: Buti offered first in the Chhaap panel, in order: motif ids from the motif library (packages/design-tokens/motifs/index.json), or a pack id naming the set of motifs tagged with it (Katha's comic_bursts).

avatars.description: Outcome family ids (template-family.v1.json) shown in the theme, in order; carrier and object kinds. The Shop shows the orderable ones.

items.description: Curated Shop item slugs, in order.

available.description: The staff switch: the Shop lists available experiences only.
